opencv.caveat: Binary reports 4.10.0-dirty. Notices use tagged sources and versions explicitly reported by the binary; this does not prove exact build inputs. ADE v0.1.2d is the tagged OpenCV build recipe default, not a revision embedded in this binary. System zlib is linked as Android libz, not treated here as a bundled OpenCV archive. ITT is dual BSD/GPLv2; BSD terms selected as permitted by ittnotify_static.c.

oneTbbThirdPartyEvidence.scope: Whole oneTBB v2021.11.0 release inventory, not a list of components proven linked into this OpenCV binary. All upstream conditions and exceptions are preserved.

sourceChecks.observation: Includes tools_api/ittnotify_static.c; oneTBB has its own ITT source path in addition to the separate OpenCV ittnotify component.
The GCC bug 62258 workaround is guarded by __GLIBCXX__, libstdc++ version >=40700 and <60000, and TBB_USE_EXCEPTIONS.
sourceChecks.inference: The OpenCV binary reports Android Clang 14.0.7 with c++_shared, so this source condition does not itself establish that the workaround is linked. Exact dirty binary inputs were not reconstructed.

oneTbbThirdPartyEvidence.licenseInterpretationLimit: Saving a release-level notice with GPL text and the complete GCC Runtime Library Exception does not by itself establish that the listed code is linked or that GPL terms apply to EPrint.

ittBsdSelectionEvidence.scope: OpenCV vendored ittnotify source explicitly permits either BSD or GPLv2; the complete BSD alternative and Copyright (c) 2005-2014 Intel Corporation are preserved. This is separate from oneTBB release-level ITT notices.

mnn.caveat: Official archive byte match proves packaged file identity, not all statically linked third-party inputs. Imported Halide header does not record its original Halide revision; v14.0.0 license is an upstream reference for matching runtime declarations/comments. cpp-httplib 0.26.0 is the version in the tagged MNN source; an exact version string was not found in the binary.
